column1: # Hand-scored meanings. Rebuild with `npm run lexicon`.
# Columns: word  pos  family  element  axes...
#   pos      n, v, a, r, or - to keep WordNet's dominant part of speech
#   family   beast construct food person body place elemental abstract sound meme, or -
#   element  fire frost storm venom stone spirit, or -
#   axes     sp speed, ma mass, ha hardness, he heat, li life, mo mood (+ hostile), or order (+ chaotic), pr presence (+ loud)
#            written like sp-2 or he+3, range -3 to +3, omitted means 0
# Seed the clearest word of a meaning cluster. Synonyms and close WordNet neighbors inherit it.
